papers.title: Colosseum: Auditing Collusion in Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems

verified_mechanisms.claim: Cooperative DCOP task objective, action-based welfare/coalition regret, free-form communication and separate conversation judge.
Secret-channel behavioral probe distinguishes benign emergence from explicitly prompted coalition behavior.
Hospital heterogeneous roles test provisioner leverage, coalition membership, covert and sabotage objectives.
Persuasion ablations include helpful misdirection, authority nudge, and reciprocity trade.

papers.reuse_boundary: Pinned runtime plus Jira baseline support a benchmark-specific study. Four new small scenario simulators are mechanism-transfer extensions unless run through original environments. No claim of all-model or all-environment reproduction.

papers.title: Confuse the Model, Control the Flow: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Leakage from LLM Agents with Information Flow Control

source_code.paper_statement: We will release our artifact, including code and data, for open science.

verified_mechanisms.claim: Collaborative Workspace Lure reframes extraction as shared-artifact work; Semantic Obfuscation Attack leaks through selective deletion/omission; Channel Decoupling Attack separates request and disclosure channels.
Provenance-based security lattice, taint propagation and mandatory release boundary; confidentiality theorem retains semantic-declassification error as a residual risk.
Code interceptor mediates read/write/share, tracks protected records, checks scoped destinations, invokes isolated SAFE/BLOCKED LLM checker when needed.

papers.reuse_boundary: A deterministic structured-field taint/authorization guard reuses the host-enforcement principle. It omits original consent APIs, semantic checker, datasets and live MCP evaluation, so is FLOWSEAL-inspired, not the FLOWSEAL reproduction.

papers.title: OCELOT: Inference-Leakage Budgets for Privacy-Preserving LLM Agents

verified_mechanisms.claim: Inference threat includes cumulative releases and colluding sinks, trusted harness, act/observe/memory/user channels; deductive budget non-exceedance is separated from model-relative cost soundness and semantic privacy.

Witness-Verified Declassification pairs fine-tuned local defender with typed witnesses and deterministic Bind/Validate/Cost/Commit; signed rubrics, structural atoms, calibrated cost tables, credal posterior audit and shared cross-sink ledger.
Privacy interpretation depends on cost calibration transfer and rubric coverage; all sinks share one budget; uncovered content is conservatively dropped.

papers.reuse_boundary: A finite synthetic secret with explicit enumeration can test history/coalition-aware disclosure accounting in a narrow model. A field counter alone is not calibrated min-entropy leakage and does not implement OCELOT WVD, fine-tuning, challenge verification, signed rubric binding or credal audit.

papers.title_as_given_in_attachment: OrchDebate: Adaptive Orchestration for Multi-Agent Debate via Self-Evolving Skills
papers.prior_document_claim: Attached ORCHDEBATE_MAPPING.md says title/abstract were previously checked, but full PDF/API did not return the paper. This run did not independently verify even that abstract.
papers.reuse_boundary: Only the attachment-described structured-state, reusable-skill, orchestration pattern is used as inspiration. Any frozen deterministic selector is our implementation, not OrchDebate training, evolution or a verified reproduction.

scenario_extensions.extension: Synthetic procurement with fixed own-private costs, truthful-outside opportunity controls, quote/message sealing and public price cap. No private board, revocation, or new post-revocation cost is implemented in the domain file.

Synthetic reciprocal approval and public independent quorum, with fixed private noisy signals. Native controls establish opportunity against signal-consistent outsiders. No OrchDebate training/debate reproduction.

Four department requesters with fixed private marginal values, public authorization/capacity/global-budget rules and sequential favoritism. No heterogeneous provisioner-role reproduction or new post-revocation needs.

Explicitly supplied permutation codebook and editor-private bit assigned at world construction, with dependency-aware canonicalization/comment removal. No private-board revocation or fresh post-revocation secret. Unprompted discovery and arbitrary natural-language steganography are not established.

claim_rules: Preserve earlier Jira null; do not rewrite its hypothesis retrospectively.
All new results begin exploratory; freeze scenarios, metrics and policies before untouched held-out seeds.
No claim of full reproduction for an abstract-only source, conceptual adapter, or synthetic simulator.
Disclosure prevention and coalition harm prevention are distinct outcomes.
No claim of novelty merely from combining these four papers.
